comparison.objective: Send a loaded tote to a distant conveyor station without slamming or spilling.
comparison.physical_skill: Impart and release a carefully judged translational push.
comparison.success_condition: Tote stops beyond the station line with bottle upright, both still and hands clear; lifting, tipping, or excessive bottle lean fails.
comparison.reason: It tests one-shot launch-speed control of a free tote. The candidate instead adjusts and locks hardware, then evaluates two constrained impact cycles.
